boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Ohio Northern University
boards.description: A current, under-21-safe set of Ada and campus destinations with published late availability; confirm schedules before leaving, especially during breaks.

cards.title: ONU C-Store
cards.subtitle: Klondike Room, Ohio Northern University
cards.notes: Use the self-service campus store when other dining locations have closed; its reported 24-hour reopening makes it a practical late option.
cards.short_summary: A campus food stop with reported around-the-clock availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Northern Review reported that ONU's 24/7 C-Store reopened March 16, 2026 and described it as the campus dining-dollar location available 24 hours a day.
cards.source_title: C-Store set to open March 16 following closure — Northern Review
cards.access_notes: Reported to reopen March 16, 2026 as a 24/7 self-service location; verify current campus access and stock before going.

cards.entity_name: WOW Café American Grill and Wingery
cards.title: WOW Café American Grill and Wingery
cards.subtitle: Ohio Northern University
cards.notes: Check the meal-exchange window for a food option that officially extends to 11 p.m., rather than relying on daytime dining schedules.
cards.short_summary: ONU lists a late-night meal-exchange period through 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU Dining's FAQ says WOW meal exchanges run 7–11 p.m. Monday–Friday and 4–11 p.m. Saturday and Sunday.
cards.source_title: Ohio Northern University Dining Frequently Asked Questions
cards.access_notes: Published late-night meal-exchange hours end at 11 p.m.; hours and access may change during academic breaks.

cards.title: Polar Bear Food Cupboard
cards.subtitle: Chapel entrance nearest the pharmacy building, ONU
cards.notes: If food insecurity is the issue, use this no-questions-asked cupboard for available nonperishable food and personal-care items during the academic year.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour academic-year resource for ONU students who need food.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU says the Polar Bear Food Cupboard is accessible 24 hours a day during the academic year and students can take what they need without questions.
cards.source_title: Polar Bear Food Cupboard | Ohio Northern University
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24 hours a day during the academic year; located in the Chapel entrance closest to the pharmacy building.

cards.title: Subway on South Main Street
cards.subtitle: 424 S Main St, Ada
cards.notes: Use the official location page to time a pickup or delivery order; it lists 10 p.m. closing every day of the week.
cards.short_summary: A daily 10 p.m. sandwich option on South Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway's official Ada location page lists store hours ending at 10 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Subway at 424 S Main St, Ada, OH
cards.access_notes: Officially listed daily hours are 8 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Saturday and 10 a.m.–10 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Cooper's Eateria
cards.subtitle: 105 S Main St, Ada
cards.notes: Plan a Tuesday–Saturday food run before the posted 10 p.m. close, and check the restaurant's own site for any schedule changes.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Ada eatery with published 10 p.m. Tuesday–Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Cooper's Eateria lists hours of 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Tuesday through Saturday and 11 a.m.–8 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Tuesday–Saturday 11 a.m.–10 p.m.; Sunday 11 a.m.–8 p.m.; closed Monday. The site says hours are subject to change.

cards.title: Ada Padrone's
cards.subtitle: 219 S Main St, Ada
cards.notes: Order ahead for pickup from this named Main Street pizza shop; the order page currently lists service until 8:30 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street pizza pickup option with an 8:30 p.m. listed close.
cards.evidence_claim: Ada Padrone's official ordering page lists its address at 219 S Main St and hours of 4–8:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The official order page lists 4–8:30 p.m.; place an order before closing and verify availability on the day.

cards.title: Viva Maria - Ada
cards.subtitle: 125 S Main St, Ada
cards.notes: Use the restaurant's direct ordering page for a carryout plan; it posts dinner service to 9 p.m. and carryout to 8:30 p.m.
cards.short_summary: An Italian-food stop with posted evening dine-in and carryout hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Viva Maria's official site lists Monday–Saturday business hours of 4–9 p.m. and carryout hours of 4–8:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are Monday–Saturday 4–9 p.m.; carryout ends at 8:30 p.m. Confirm operating status before travel.

cards.title: Drug and Health Information Center
cards.subtitle: ONU HealthWise, Ohio Northern University
cards.notes: For a late health-information question, call during the published evening window instead of treating it as an emergency care substitute.
cards.short_summary: A campus health-information service that publishes 10 p.m. weekday availability.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU HealthWise lists Drug and Health Information Center hours of 9 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Friday and 7–10 p.m. Sunday, with no charges for services.
cards.access_notes: Published hours are Monday–Friday 9 a.m.–10 p.m. and Sunday 7–10 p.m.; it is closed Saturday. This is not emergency care.

cards.entity_name: The Inn at Ohio Northern University 24-Hour Fitness Room
cards.title: The Inn at ONU 24-Hour Fitness Room
cards.subtitle: The Inn at Ohio Northern University, Ada
cards.notes: For guests staying at The Inn, use the listed 24-hour fitness room as an indoor late-evening activity; follow hotel access requirements.
cards.short_summary: A hotel guest amenity with stated 24-hour fitness-room access.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU's Summer Orientation page says all Inn room rates include access to the 24-hour fitness room.
cards.source_title: Summer Orientation and Welcome Weekend | Ohio Northern University
cards.access_notes: The 24-hour fitness room is described as included with Inn room rates; access is for hotel guests and may be subject to hotel rules.

cards.title: Old Route 69 Brewery Dining Room
cards.subtitle: 120 E Buckeye Ave, Ada
cards.notes: For an early-weekend meal, consult the restaurant's direct ordering page and use its published food-service schedule rather than bar hours.
cards.short_summary: A downtown dining room whose ordering page lists 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Old Route 69 Brewery's direct Toast ordering page lists Friday and Saturday hours of 11 a.m.–10 p.m. and identifies food service including sandwiches, burgers, salads, and pizza.
cards.access_notes: Published food-ordering hours run to 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday; choose food service and confirm current availability before going.

warnings: Several destinations have limited late hours rather than all-night service; verify same-day hours, academic-break schedules, and access requirements.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Ohio Northern spaces for studying, gathering, performances, reflection, and campus events, each supported by a direct university source.

cards.title: Mifsud Collaborative Learning Center
cards.subtitle: First floor, Heterick Memorial Library
cards.notes: Set up a group work session in the open, media-rich first-floor learning area, then use the library’s room tools if your group needs a reservable space.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative study setting inside Heterick Memorial Library.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU describes the Mifsud Collaborative Learning Center as an open, comfortable, well-lit, media-rich collaborative-learning space on Heterick Library’s first floor.
cards.access_notes: Use during library access hours; consult the library for room availability and reservations.

cards.title: Heterick Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: 525 South Main Street, Ada
cards.notes: Choose a study spot, ask a librarian for research help, or plan an archives visit in advance when you need university-history materials.
cards.short_summary: ONU’s library for research support, study, and archival materials.
cards.evidence_claim: Heterick Memorial Library offers library resources and research help, and its archives reading room is on the third floor; archives access is by appointment.
cards.access_notes: Archives access requires an appointment; confirm library hours before visiting.

cards.title: The Tundra
cards.subtitle: Between residence halls and academic buildings
cards.notes: Use the broad lawn as a daylight meet-up point or check the campus calendar for events scheduled on this central green.
cards.short_summary: An 8.56-acre campus lawn used for events and student downtime.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU identifies the Tundra as the grassy area between residence halls and academic buildings and says it serves as a location for events and student downtime.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space; use consideration for scheduled events and weather conditions.

cards.title: English Chapel
cards.subtitle: 525 South Main Street, Ada
cards.notes: Attend Thursday Spiritual Hour, visit for a scheduled student gathering, or contact Religious and Spiritual Life about programs and space access.
cards.short_summary: A campus chapel hosting Spiritual Hour and religious-life programming.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU lists Thursday 11 a.m. Spiritual Hour in English Chapel/Burgett and describes the chapel as a longstanding center of campus spirituality.
cards.source_title: Religious and Spiritual Life | Ohio Northern University
cards.access_notes: Program times and building access vary; contact the Office of Religious and Spiritual Life for arrangements.

cards.title: Bear Cave
cards.subtitle: McIntosh Center
cards.notes: Look for a campus event using the Bear Cave, or ask McIntosh Center staff whether the space is available for a student program.
cards.short_summary: A named McIntosh Center venue used for university programming.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU’s 2026 Oratory & Art Festival lists the Bear Cave and McIntosh Center as its location.
cards.source_title: Camps & Summer Classes | Ohio Northern University
cards.access_notes: Event and room availability vary; confirm access with McIntosh Center staff.

cards.title: Sculpture Mall
cards.subtitle: East of McIntosh Center, between Presser and Weber halls
cards.notes: Use this named outdoor campus stretch as a meeting point before a nearby event, keeping clear of activities that have reserved the lawn.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor mall east of McIntosh Center between Presser and Weber halls.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU places its Oratory & Art Festival on the sculpture mall east of McIntosh Center between Presser and Weber halls.
cards.source_title: Camps & Summer Classes | Ohio Northern University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor area; availability can be affected by scheduled campus events.

cards.entity_name: Freed Center for the Performing Arts
cards.title: Freed Center for the Performing Arts
cards.subtitle: 525 South Main Street, Ada
cards.notes: Check the season calendar for a student production, concert, or visiting act, and use the box office for current ticket and accessibility details.
cards.short_summary: ONU’s performing-arts venue for student productions and visiting acts.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU says student productions fill the Freed Center during the season and identifies it as a campus performing-arts venue.
cards.access_notes: Performance admission and availability vary by event; the box office is open Monday through Friday, noon to 4:30 p.m.

cards.title: Biggs Theatre
cards.subtitle: Freed Center for the Performing Arts
cards.notes: Reserve or pick up tickets for an announced performance, then arrive before curtain time and follow the venue’s late-seating guidance.
cards.short_summary: The Freed Center’s 551-seat main theatre.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU identifies Biggs Theatre as a 551-seat theatre within the Freed Center and notes wheelchair-accessible seating on two levels.
cards.access_notes: Ticket requirements vary by event; wheelchair-accessible seating and assisted listening devices are available.

cards.title: Stambaugh Studio Theatre
cards.subtitle: Freed Center for the Performing Arts
cards.notes: Watch the Freed Center schedule for a studio-theatre event, and check with the box office about ticketing and seating before you go.
cards.short_summary: A flexible studio theatre at the Freed Center.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU identifies Stambaugh Studio Theatre as a Freed Center venue with 34 seats per section and a 136-seat maximum capacity.
cards.access_notes: Ticket requirements and event availability vary; contact the Freed Center box office for current details.

cards.title: ONU Sports Center Field House
cards.subtitle: 609 Lincoln Avenue, Ada
cards.notes: Check the athletics or university events calendar before visiting; the field house hosts major assemblies and other scheduled campus functions.
cards.short_summary: A field house used for athletics, recreation, assemblies, and commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU states that the Sports Center accommodates intercollegiate athletics, physical education, recreation activities, commencements, special events, and assembly programs.
cards.access_notes: Access depends on athletics, recreation, and event scheduling; follow posted event instructions.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-purchase ONU activities, resources, and recurring community events with direct university evidence of free access.

cards.title: Catch a Student Planning Committee event
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide weekly entertainment
cards.notes: Check ONU announcements for the Student Planning Committee’s weekly entertainment, then go with friends; ONU says its programming is always free for students.
cards.short_summary: A recurring, student-focused free entertainment option.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU states that the Student Planning Committee puts on free entertainment each week for all students.
cards.access_notes: For ONU students; check campus announcements for the specific event, date, and location.

cards.title: Attend the ONU Oratory & Art Festival
cards.subtitle: Bear Cave and McIntosh Center — October 24, 2026
cards.notes: Register as a supporter or attend with an invited participant to see student speech, performance, and visual art at this stated free campus festival.
cards.short_summary: A one-day student-expression festival with art and performance.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU lists the October 24, 2026 Oratory & Art Festival at Bear Cave and McIntosh Center as free, with food and beverages provided.
cards.access_notes: The 2026 listing identifies high-school students and educators as participants; supporters are encouraged to register to attend.

cards.title: Bring a blanket to Patriotic Pops
cards.subtitle: Sculpture Mall east of McIntosh Center
cards.notes: When the every-other-July concert returns, bring lawn chairs or a blanket and meet friends on the sculpture mall for the outdoor Lima Symphony performance.
cards.short_summary: A recurring outdoor campus concert presented without admission.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU says its every-other-July Patriotic Pops concert with the Lima Symphony Orchestra is a free public concert on campus.
cards.access_notes: Recurring every other July; ONU directs attendees to the sculpture mall east of McIntosh Center and advises bringing chairs or blankets.

cards.title: Browse a DigitalCommons@ONU rabbit hole
cards.subtitle: Online repository from ONU Libraries
cards.notes: Open a collection together, pick a campus-created paper, image, or publication, and compare what you find; the repository is available without a purchase.
cards.short_summary: A free online window into ONU scholarship and creative work.
cards.evidence_claim: DigitalCommons@ONU provides free and open access to scholarship and creative works from ONU faculty, students, staff, and units.
cards.source_title: DigitalCommons@ONU - Ohio Northern University Digital Repository
cards.access_notes: Online access; no campus entry or ONU login is stated as required for browsing the open repository.

cards.title: Make a study meetup at ONU Tutoring
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Heterick Memorial Library
cards.notes: Bring a classmate to a drop-in session or book an appointment; the program covers many undergraduate courses and can help locate support when needed.
cards.short_summary: Free academic help that can turn a tough assignment into a shared work session.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU offers free weekly drop-in and by-appointment tutoring for many undergraduate courses.
cards.access_notes: For ONU students; tutoring is located on the second floor of Heterick Memorial Library. Contact tutoring@onu.edu for availability.

cards.title: Use the Career Closet together
cards.subtitle: Center for Student Success, Heterick Memorial Library
cards.notes: Coordinate a visit with the Polar Career Center if you need interview or event clothing, then help a friend choose pieces suited to their upcoming occasion.
cards.short_summary: A donated-clothing resource for ONU students preparing for professional events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Polar Career Center says its Career Closet resource is offered free of charge to ONU students.
cards.source_title: Polar Career Center | Ohio Northern University
cards.access_notes: For ONU students; arrange a time with Polar Career Center staff. The office is on Heterick Memorial Library’s second floor.

cards.title: Build a Handshake profile side by side
cards.subtitle: Online career-exploration activity
cards.notes: Use your ONU email to create an account with a friend, fill in interests, and browse the platform’s job, internship, employer, and virtual-event options.
cards.short_summary: A free online career platform for ONU students.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU’s Polar Careers page instructs students to create a free Handshake account using their .edu email address.
cards.source_title: Career Exploration and Resources | Ohio Northern University
cards.access_notes: Requires an ONU .edu email address to create the free account.

cards.entity_name: ONU Volunteer Income Tax Assistance Program
cards.title: Book free VITA tax-prep help
cards.subtitle: Dicke College of Business Administration
cards.notes: If you meet the income guideline, ask about ONU’s VITA service and bring required tax documents; business students prepare returns for Ada residents and fellow students.
cards.short_summary: Free tax-return preparation for eligible local residents and students.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU describes its VITA program as providing free tax-return preparation for individuals and families making about $70,000 or less annually.
cards.source_title: Justin Zollars: VITA volunteer | Ohio Northern University
cards.access_notes: Eligibility is income-limited; confirm seasonal appointment details and required documents with the Dicke College of Business Administration.

cards.title: Use the free walk-in health clinic
cards.subtitle: Available to all ONU students
cards.notes: If you need non-emergency care, use the walk-in clinic for an assessment, treatment, or referral; consider inviting a trusted friend to accompany you if appropriate.
cards.short_summary: A student-accessible walk-in clinic for general health support.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU states that it has a free walk-in health clinic available to all students for general assessments, treatments, and referrals.
cards.access_notes: For ONU students; this is a health service rather than a social venue. Use emergency services for emergencies.

cards.title: Do a no-charge laundry reset
cards.subtitle: Residence-hall common areas
cards.notes: Use your residence hall’s common-area machines during a planned reset with roommates; bring your own supplies and follow your building’s shared-space expectations.
cards.short_summary: A practical, no-charge shared facility for residential students.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU states that residence-hall common areas include high-efficiency laundry machines with no charge for use.
cards.access_notes: For ONU residence-hall students and their assigned building’s common areas; laundry supplies are not stated as provided.

warnings: Some options are student-only or event-specific; review the cited source and current campus communications before going.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Ohio Northern environments for independent work, group projects, research, writing, tutoring, or focused reset time.

cards.title: Heterick Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: 525 South Main Street, Ada
cards.notes: Start here for library resources, then choose a floor or reservable room that fits the work you need to finish.
cards.short_summary: ONU’s undergraduate library, with research help and multiple study settings.
cards.evidence_claim: Heterick Memorial Library provides library resources and has rooms for individual study and small or large groups.
cards.access_notes: Check current library hours and room-reservation availability before going.

cards.entity_name: Oscar J. and Judith D. Mifsud Collaborative Learning Center
cards.title: Mifsud Collaborative Learning Center
cards.subtitle: First floor, Heterick Memorial Library
cards.notes: Bring a project partner and use the first-floor collaborative setting for shared screens, whiteboard work, or discussion.
cards.short_summary: A media-rich first-floor learning environment designed for collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU identifies the first floor of Heterick as the Mifsud Collaborative Learning Center, an open, media-rich collaborative-learning space.
cards.access_notes: Use during library access hours; check reservation information for enclosed rooms.

cards.title: Mifsud Center for Student Success
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Heterick Memorial Library
cards.notes: Set up with course materials in the renovated second-floor areas, then connect with academic support if you need it.
cards.short_summary: Renovated second-floor space with areas for individual and collaborative study.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU says the Mifsud Center’s renovated second floor includes expanded areas for students to study individually or collaborate on projects.
cards.source_title: ONU celebrates opening of Mifsud Center for Student Success
cards.access_notes: Located on Heterick’s second floor; support-service availability may vary.

cards.title: Sensory Room
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Heterick Memorial Library
cards.notes: Reserve a 30-minute session when adjustable lighting, cozy seating, and a calmer reset would help you refocus.
cards.short_summary: A reservable, private room for mindfulness and stress reduction.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sensory Room is open to the ONU community, accommodates up to three people for 30 minutes, and includes adjustable lighting and cozy seating.
cards.access_notes: Reserve for up to three people for 30 minutes; it is open to the ONU community.

cards.title: Writing Center
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Heterick Memorial Library
cards.notes: Bring a draft, outline, or research paper question and use a session to move the next revision forward.
cards.short_summary: Writing support space for ONU students at any stage of the process.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU’s Writing Center supports all ONU students at any stage of the writing process and is part of the Heterick-based Student Success Center.
cards.access_notes: Located in the second-floor Student Success area; confirm appointment or drop-in details with the center.

cards.title: Tutoring Center
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Heterick Memorial Library
cards.notes: Take a problem set or course question to a drop-in or scheduled tutoring session, then plan your next practice block.
cards.short_summary: Heterick-based tutoring for many undergraduate courses.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU offers free weekly drop-in and by-appointment tutoring for many undergraduate courses from its second-floor Heterick location.
cards.access_notes: Tutoring is on Heterick’s second floor; availability depends on course coverage and appointment schedules.

cards.title: Math and Statistics Resource Center
cards.subtitle: Tutoring services at Heterick Memorial Library
cards.notes: Use this tutoring setting for a 1000-level math or statistics question, then leave with a worked next step.
cards.short_summary: One-on-one tutoring support for introductory math and statistics courses.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU states that the Math and Statistics Resource Center provides one-on-one tutoring for all 1000-level mathematics and statistics courses.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current tutoring schedule and course coverage before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Ohio Northern University Archives Public Reading Room
cards.title: ONU Archives Public Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Third floor, Heterick Memorial Library
cards.notes: Schedule a visit before working with historical manuscripts, photographs, maps, or university publications in the reading room.
cards.short_summary: Appointment-based primary-source research space in Heterick Library.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU Archives materials are available for use in its public reading room on Heterick Memorial Library’s third floor.
cards.access_notes: Archives access is by appointment; contact archives@onu.edu to schedule a visit.

cards.title: Taggart Law Library
cards.subtitle: Pettit College of Law, Ohio Northern University
cards.notes: Use individual or group study areas with legal research tools when your work calls for cases, statutes, or study aids.
cards.short_summary: Law-library setting with technology-equipped individual and group study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Taggart Law Library provides multiple group and individual study spaces with embedded technology, alongside legal research resources.
cards.access_notes: Confirm visitor and access policies with the law library before relying on a study space.

cards.entity_name: David C. Crago Rare Book Room
cards.title: David C. Crago Rare Book Room
cards.subtitle: Taggart Law Library, Pettit College of Law
cards.notes: Ask library staff about access before planning research with the room’s rare legal materials and special collections.
cards.short_summary: Special-collections room for rare legal materials and faculty publications.
cards.evidence_claim: The David C. Crago Rare Book Room in Taggart Law Library houses rare legal materials and special collections.
cards.access_notes: Special-collections access rules are not stated on the page; contact Taggart Law Library before visiting.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten distinct, named destinations on campus-adjacent Ada corridors, each with a directly sourced reason to stop.

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor • 530 S Main St
cards.notes: Use this South Main stop when you need a food option near ONU’s front edge; the official locator lists this Ada restaurant and its address.
cards.short_summary: A chain-food stop on the campus-facing end of South Main.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists an Ada location at 530 South Main Street.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Ada, OH
cards.access_notes: Check the official store page for current hours and service options.

cards.title: Starbucks at ONU
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor • 534 S Main St
cards.notes: Make this a campus-edge coffee or snack stop; the county tourism office identifies Starbucks at 534 South Main Street on the ONU campus.
cards.short_summary: A Starbucks location at ONU’s South Main entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: Hardin County’s tourism page identifies Starbucks at 534 South Main Street and says it is located at the Ohio Northern University campus.
cards.source_title: Places to Sip | Hardin County Chamber & Business Alliance
cards.access_notes: Confirm current store hours through Starbucks before going.

cards.title: Subway
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor • Ada
cards.notes: Use the official Ada location listing to confirm service before walking over; it provides a straightforward sandwich-and-salad option on South Main.
cards.short_summary: An Ada Subway location on the South Main corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway’s official locator lists a location in Ada, Ohio.
cards.access_notes: Use Subway’s official locator for the current address, hours, and ordering options.

cards.title: Ada Padrone's
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor • 219 S Main St
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s live menu before heading north on Main; its official page lists online ordering and the Ada street address.
cards.short_summary: A pizza restaurant on the downtown stretch of South Main.
cards.evidence_claim: Ada Padrone’s official page lists the restaurant at 219 S Main Street in Ada and provides its menu and ordering link.
cards.access_notes: The official page shows current ordering information; verify availability before visiting.

cards.title: Ada Theatre
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor • 215 S Main St
cards.notes: Look up the current film and showtime, then walk to this downtown Main Street theater; its official site posts the schedule and ticket information.
cards.short_summary: A single-screen movie theater in downtown Ada.
cards.evidence_claim: Ada Theatre’s official site lists its location at 215 S Main Street in Ada and posts current films and showtimes.
cards.access_notes: Check the theater’s official page for the current film, showtime, and ticket details.

cards.title: El Campo Mexican Restaurant
cards.subtitle: North Main Street corridor • 204 N Main St
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s contact page to check hours or arrange takeout before going; it gives the North Main address and reservation option.
cards.short_summary: A Mexican restaurant just north of the downtown Main intersection.
cards.evidence_claim: El Campo Mexican Restaurant’s official contact page lists 204 N Main Street, Ada, and says takeout is available.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists current hours; check it before visiting or placing a takeout order.

cards.title: Ada Public Library
cards.subtitle: North Main Street corridor • 320 N Main St
cards.notes: Bring a book, use library resources, or check the program calendar at this North Main public library; its contact page lists address and hours.
cards.short_summary: A public-library stop farther up North Main.
cards.evidence_claim: Ada Public Library lists its address as 320 N Main Street and publishes its weekly hours.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by day; verify them on the library’s official contact page.

cards.title: Village of Ada Offices
cards.subtitle: West Buckeye Avenue corridor • 115 W Buckeye Ave
cards.notes: Stop here for village-government information or use the official site to locate public notices; the office sits one block west of downtown Main.
cards.short_summary: The municipal office on the westbound Buckeye corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Village of Ada’s official website lists its address as 115 West Buckeye Avenue in Ada.
cards.access_notes: Use the Village website for current office notices and contact information.

cards.title: Ada Depot Railroad Park
cards.subtitle: East Central Avenue corridor • beside Central Avenue
cards.notes: Walk the Central Avenue side of downtown to see the depot park; a Village council record identifies Central Avenue directly south of the park.
cards.short_summary: A named depot park beside the East Central corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: A Village of Ada council record refers to a portion of Central Avenue directly south of Depot Railroad Park and its parking lot.
cards.source_title: Village of Ada Council Meeting Record
cards.access_notes: This is an outdoor public-space stop; observe any posted park or event restrictions.

cards.title: Wilson Ada Football Factory
cards.subtitle: East Highland Avenue corridor • 517 E Highland Ave
cards.notes: Book a factory tour or visit the retail store and small museum; Wilson’s Ada page describes all three and gives the East Highland location.
cards.short_summary: A football-making factory with tours, retail, and a small museum.
cards.evidence_claim: Wilson says its Ada factory offers bookable tours, a retail store, and a small museum at 517 E Highland Avenue.
cards.source_title: Ada, Ohio Football Factory | Wilson Sporting Goods
cards.access_notes: Tours require online booking; Wilson lists factory hours separately from tour availability.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Ohio Northern traditions, from orientation rituals to long-running campus events.

cards.title: Sign and Paint the Spirit Rock
cards.subtitle: Between Heterick Memorial Library and McIntosh Center
cards.notes: See the rock during orientation, then reserve an approved painting slot with your group for a campus event or organization.
cards.short_summary: New Polar Bears sign it, while campus groups use it to mark events and show spirit.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU identifies signing the Spirit Rock as a new-student activity and describes painting it as a tradition supporting events, clubs, and organizations.
cards.access_notes: Painting requires an approved reservation; visit during public orientation or campus events.

cards.title: Welcome Spring with the Festival of Colors
cards.subtitle: Ohio Northern University, Ada, Ohio
cards.notes: Watch ONU event listings in spring and join only as directed; wear clothes suitable for colored powder and follow event guidance.
cards.short_summary: ONU marks spring’s arrival with a campus Festival of Colors based on the Hindu celebration of Holi.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU lists the Festival of Colors among its traditions and says the campus celebrates spring’s arrival with the Hindu Festival of Colors.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current event details and participation guidance with ONU before attending.

cards.title: Get Down and Dirty at Mud Volleyball
cards.subtitle: Founders Hall area, Ohio Northern University
cards.notes: Look for the fall tournament schedule and participate through its organizers; bring a change of clothes and follow staff directions.
cards.short_summary: ONU calls this annual fall tournament the unofficial start of the school year.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU describes its annual Mud Volleyball Tournament as a fall event and the unofficial start of the school year.
cards.access_notes: Participation is event-organized; follow current Residence Life and event safety instructions.

cards.title: Find the Sweetheart Benches
cards.subtitle: Campus stone benches, Ohio Northern University
cards.notes: Walk campus and read the bench inscriptions respectfully; use the benches as a quiet stop rather than treating them as props.
cards.short_summary: Stone benches around campus commemorate relationships formed among ONU Polar Bears.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU says stone benches scattered across campus commemorate Polar Bear sweethearts, who often become engaged on campus.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus feature; respect inscriptions and nearby pedestrian access.

cards.title: Remember ONU May Day
cards.subtitle: Ohio Northern University, Ada, Ohio
cards.notes: Use ONU’s history page to spot the archival tug-of-war image and learn how this postwar campus tradition entered the record.
cards.short_summary: May Day is a documented ONU tradition established in the post–World War II era.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU’s institutional history states that May Day was established as an ONU tradition in the post–World War II period.
cards.access_notes: This is a historical tradition; check current ONU programming for any present-day observance.

cards.title: Meet Klondike’s Century-Old Tradition
cards.subtitle: Ohio Northern University mascot tradition
cards.notes: Look for Klondike at university events and compare the current mascot with ONU’s archival images of earlier Polar Bear designs.
cards.short_summary: The Polar Bear became ONU’s official mascot in 1923; the mascot received the name Klondike in 1998.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU reports that students selected the Polar Bear as the mascot in 1923 and that the mascot was officially named Klondike in 1998.
cards.access_notes: Mascot appearances vary by event; consult current ONU athletics or event information.

cards.title: Serve on ACE Day
cards.subtitle: Ada community and Ohio Northern University
cards.notes: Ask orientation staff about the current ACE Day assignment, then arrive prepared to complete the service activity with your group.
cards.short_summary: Incoming Polar Bears take part in an annual service-learning day connecting them with Ada organizations and residents.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU describes ACE Day as an annual service-learning program in which incoming students assist local organizations and people.
cards.access_notes: Typically coordinated through new-student programming; confirm current orientation requirements and assignment details.

cards.title: Hear the Pre-season Fight Song Practice
cards.subtitle: Football, marching band, and cheerleaders
cards.notes: Check ONU athletics and marching-band schedules for a public appearance, then support the performers from designated spectator areas.
cards.short_summary: ONU brings football players, the marching band, and cheerleaders together to practice the fight song before the season.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU calls the joint football team, marching band, and cheerleader fight-song practice a favorite pre-season tradition.
cards.access_notes: Practice access and timing can vary; verify the current schedule before making a trip.

cards.entity_name: ONU Law Oath of Professionalism and Pinning Ceremony
cards.title: Mark Law Orientation with the Pinning Ceremony
cards.subtitle: Ohio Northern University College of Law
cards.notes: If you are an incoming law student, follow College of Law orientation instructions for the oath and pinning ceremony.
cards.short_summary: Law orientation includes an oath of professionalism and a pinning ceremony that ONU describes as long-held.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU identifies the Oath of Professionalism and Pinning Ceremony during law orientation as a long-held ONU Law tradition.
cards.access_notes: Intended for new College of Law students and their orientation program.

cards.title: Catch Warm Cookie Wednesdays
cards.subtitle: ONU dining tradition
cards.notes: Check dining announcements for the current Wednesday location and timing, then stop by during normal campus dining access.
cards.short_summary: A dining employee greets students on Wednesdays with cookies fresh from the oven.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU describes Warm Cookie Wednesdays as an ONU tradition in which students are greeted with trays of warm cookies each Wednesday.
cards.access_notes: Availability and dining access may change; confirm with current ONU Dining information.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Ohio Northern University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A campus-based, under-21-safe sequence built from ONU’s current Welcome Weekend and student-life information.

cards.title: Start by signing the Spirit Rock
cards.subtitle: Welcome Weekend arrival stop
cards.notes: Find the Spirit Rock during move-in programming, add your signature if the event is offered, then use the nearby campus activity as an icebreaker.
cards.short_summary: A documented Welcome Weekend stop for new Polar Bears.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU’s 2026 Welcome Weekend schedule lists Spirit Rock Signing for new Polar Bears at the Spirit Rock.
cards.source_title: Summer Orientation and Welcome Weekend | Ohio Northern University
cards.access_notes: Participate when Welcome Weekend programming schedules the activity.

cards.title: Get oriented at McIntosh Center
cards.subtitle: Check-in, services, and gathering point
cards.notes: Use the center as a practical first stop: confirm your schedule, locate student-facing offices, and note the dining hall before heading to other events.
cards.short_summary: A central Welcome Weekend check-in and campus-services location.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU lists McIntosh Center’s Activities Room for student ID, parking, commuter, and transfer Welcome Weekend check-in tasks.
cards.source_title: Summer Orientation and Welcome Weekend | Ohio Northern University
cards.access_notes: Use the event schedule and posted office information for current access.

cards.title: Share a meal at McIntosh Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Inside McIntosh Center
cards.notes: Plan a meal-window meet-up here, then keep the conversation going by choosing one afternoon program or campus walk together.
cards.short_summary: ONU’s primary campus dining gathering place.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU identifies McIntosh Dining Hall in McIntosh Center as its primary gathering place and describes its all-you-care-to-eat dining environment.
cards.access_notes: Food requires an applicable meal plan or purchase; check current dining service information.

cards.title: Locate English Chapel between sessions
cards.subtitle: Welcome Weekend program venue
cards.notes: Walk over while the campus is active and identify the sanctuary entrance so future student-life or academic sessions are easy to find.
cards.short_summary: A named venue used in ONU’s new-student schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU’s Summer Orientation schedules student-life and academic sessions in the English Chapel sanctuary.
cards.source_title: Summer Orientation and Welcome Weekend | Ohio Northern University
cards.access_notes: Attend scheduled programs or visit in accordance with university access practices.

cards.title: Make Heterick your study rendezvous
cards.subtitle: Library and student-resource stop
cards.notes: Pick a seat, test the route from your residence hall, and save the library contact details for research help once classes begin.
cards.short_summary: A campus library with study spaces and student resources.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU describes Heterick Memorial Library as an updated facility with open study spaces, huddle rooms, and student library resources.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current posted hours before visiting.

cards.title: Take a library refresh break
cards.subtitle: Retail café at Heterick
cards.notes: Pair a short café stop with a library orientation: identify a study area first, then return with any drink or snack you purchase.
cards.short_summary: A named on-campus retail dining option at the library.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU lists Northern Lights Café among its on-campus retail dining locations and its accepted-student guide places it in Heterick Library.
cards.access_notes: Purchases are optional; verify current service hours before relying on it.

cards.title: Walk the Green Monster
cards.subtitle: Campus outdoor track
cards.notes: Take a daylight walk or ride with a new classmate, using the full route as an easy way to see more of campus without a fixed agenda.
cards.short_summary: ONU’s named 2.5-mile outdoor campus track.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU identifies the Green Monster as an emerald-green outdoor campus track for walking, biking, or rollerblading and states it is 2.5 miles long.
cards.access_notes: Use in daylight and follow posted campus recreation and safety guidance.

cards.title: Find King Horn Field House
cards.subtitle: Campus recreation and convocation venue
cards.notes: Orient yourself to the field house during an open program, then note its fitness, court, track, and pool facilities for later recreation plans.
cards.short_summary: A named campus athletic and recreation complex.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU’s accepted-student guide describes King Horn as a complex with cardio and weight rooms, sports courts, an indoor track, and a pool.
cards.access_notes: Facility access and recreation availability can vary; consult current university information.

cards.entity_name: Freed Center for the Performing Arts
cards.title: Check the Freed Center calendar
cards.subtitle: 525 South Main Street
cards.notes: Look for a student production or public performance, save the venue location, and make a plan with friends once tickets or entry details are confirmed.
cards.short_summary: ONU’s performing-arts venue for student productions and events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Freed Center says student productions fill its season and lists its address as 525 South Main Street in Ada.
cards.source_title: Freed Center at ONU | Performing Arts & Musical Theater | ONU
cards.access_notes: Performance admission and timing vary by event; consult the current calendar or box office.

cards.title: Try an SPC event with your floor
cards.subtitle: Recurring student-programming option
cards.notes: Ask your residence-hall group what SPC has scheduled, choose an age-appropriate event, and use it as a low-pressure way to meet people.
cards.short_summary: A documented source of weekly student entertainment.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU’s accepted-student guide describes the Student Planning Committee as a student organization that provides free weekly entertainment for students.
cards.access_notes: Event format, location, and eligibility vary; use the current student event listing.
